text:
Explicit revision retaining accepted requirements and existing business operations. Correct the retained proposal, not permissions or limits. It still uses nonboolean requires and incorrect each identifiers.

For extract_home_pages, extract_after_cookie_pages, extract_search_result_pages and extract_product_pages, each MUST be exactly {"input":"pages","output":"page_facts"}: input names an EXISTING entry of that task's inputs, output names its EXISTING sole array result field. The current invented home_snapshot_page/post_cookie_snapshot_page/etc. names are not bound inputs. Keep page_facts as an array of per-page facts; no scripts or runtime item names in TaskPlan.

For ordinary operations/tasks with no extra execution precondition, requires should be null. Do NOT place input(query), output(array/object/string), or item in requires. Data bindings already impose data dependencies. For producer completion use {"kind":"present","source":"actual_accessible_task_id"}. For value comparison use a kind=predicate with predicate=equal/not_equal and items. Fix every nonboolean requires shown in diagnostics. For example open_amazon_home.requires=null; decide_home_state.requires={"kind":"present","source":"extract_home_pages"}; product_item_flow.requires=null. Keep the actual nullable-reference predicates on click/fill and actual completeness/blocker checks. assemble_final_products currently requires blocked=true, which reverses the intended path; successful output must require unblocked work and completed real visits. Fail explicitly on a blocker or incomplete capture, preserve cleanup, and never publish a successful synthetic blocker product row.

Extraction output contracts must contain only actual observed values or permitted optional absence. The producer pages do not declare page_index, observed_order, coverage_note, source_label or synthesized relevant_text. Remove these artificial extraction requirements. Preserve original page/item ordering directly and observed DOM group/text/href/reference/actions where needed; no invented counters, labels or coverage claims. Use arrays of observed candidate records/text for compaction, empty only after observed absence. Meaningful state/status classification belongs to compact interpretation. Source completeness is guarded from original snapshot flags (captureTruncated and manifestTruncated plus observation complete), not generated coverage notes.

Preserve the actual query binding through observed fill+submit, matching conditional ports, nullable guards, sequential product visits, exact product field evidence, actual document_write and its returned path, and unconditional Browser closure. Keep all five accepted requirements and the existing public input/output interface.
